case.title: A star in Scorpius brightened ninefold in August 2017 and Gaia never alerted: a microlensing candidate
case.hook: Found blind in Oddsky hunt H-0008 (NEOWISE x8 in W1 and W2 on 2017 Aug 17). ATLAS shows one smooth, achromatic event peaking in mid-August 2017; a point lens with annual parallax fits. Gaia scanned it during the event without an alert; DR4 will show what it saw.

claims.text: NEOWISE on 2017 Aug 17: x8 brighter in both W1 and W2 than the star's 2014-2024 median; every other visit quiet. Found blind by hunt H-0008.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: ATLAS (task 5273734) shows one smooth brightening in 2016-2026, peaking at x6-9 in mid-August 2017 and back to normal by early 2018. A point lens fits only with annual parallax (piE ~0.38 in every reduction); tE ~120-190 d (hunts/H-0008/reviews/claude-referee-atlas10-2026-10-30.md).
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: Gaia scanned the star 19 d before, 3 d after and 33 d after the ATLAS peak and issued no alert; Gaia alerted on only 5 of 12 comparable DR3 lenses, so the missing alert is weak evidence (hunts/H-0009/predictions/dr4_referee.md).
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: Not in TNS, the Gaia alerts, the KMTNet, OGLE or ZTF microlensing lists, or a web search (2026-10-30). MOA and ASAS-SN not checked.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

hypotheses.statement: A foreground lens magnified the star for about four months in 2017 (P 0.75, ATLAS-follow-up referee).
hypotheses.would_falsify: Gaia DR4 flat during the event, or a repeat.
hypotheses.author: claude-opus-5.5

predictions.statement: Gaia DR4 G epoch photometry of Gaia DR3 6020322385418675200 (or the DR4 source cross-matched to it): the median G of the transits in MJD 57949-58042 (2017-07-15 to 2017-10-16 00:00; forecast 6 transits on Jul 29, Aug 20 and Sep 19) is more than 1.2 mag brighter than the median G in MJD 56863.5-57570 (2014-07-25 to 2016-07-01). Model: 1.6-2.1 mag.
predictions.author: claude-opus-5.5

notes: parallax too uncertain for an absolute magnitude (parallax_over_error <= 5)

query.adql: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmdec, ruwe, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, phot_variable_flag, teff_gspphot, distance_gspphot, non_single_star, DISTANCE(POINT(248.915374,-35.86921), POINT(ra,dec))*3600 AS sep_arcsec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT(ra,dec), CIRCLE(248.915374,-35.86921,0.008333333333333333)) ORDER BY sep_arcsec
